title: MR-CCC: Bayesian Mendelian Randomization for Causal Cell-Cell Communication (analysis code)

description: Analysis code for MR-CCC, a Bayesian Mendelian randomization framework for causal ligand-receptor cell-cell communication with receptor-modulated ligand effects. Reproduces the simulation studies, the OneK1K real-data analysis, and all figures.
